In parseFasta a bare line before any '>' never enters the acculumator: line 8865 `} else if (header) {` drops it, so a ruler pasted without a header line is ignored entirely (no rows) — correct. A ruler pasted UNDER an existing record that has letters (the normal case, e.g. 'ACGT...' plus a '....|....| 40' ruler) makes raw contain '|' or letters, so `/^[0-9?.\-]+$/` fails, `states` at 8736 is false, and line 8869 still strips the digits from `seq` — unchanged.
